Leah Park: After the postmortem, we need a clear handoff plan so runbook edits actually get shipped and tested. Propose: owner + shadow + QA step for each item, 10-day window.

Owen J.: I can own the playbook checklist (triage commands, quick mitigations, escalation matrix). Will pair with a shadow for the QA run.

SRE Team: Suggest the shadow be from DB oncall for at least one drill. Add a closure checklist: PR merged, tabletop done, smoke test passing.

Leah Park: Agreed. Short action list: (1) Playbook checklist (owner: Owen) due 2026-04-07, shadow: DB oncall (assign: Maya). (2) Automated recurrence detector PR (owner: SRE Team) due 2026-04-21. (3) Closure QA run (owner: Maya) due 2026-04-10. I'll open GH issues prefixed pm-2026-142.

Owen J.: Quick copyable triage commands to add to runbook:
```
# check pgbouncer state
systemctl status pgbouncer || journalctl -u pgbouncer -n 200
# active vs waiting
psql -h primary -c "select state, count(*) from pg_stat_activity group by state;"
# prometheus quick check
curl -s "http://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(pgbouncer_connection_failures_total[5m]))"
```

TicketBot: Created issue pm-2026-142-1: https://redwood.internal/issues/pm-2026-142-1

Leah Park: I'll schedule a 45min tabletop with DB + infra on 2026-04-09 16:00 UTC. If anyone can't make the deadlines, post here with a new ETA. Thanks.
